name: acp

name: config

name: grep

description: Opt in to `ask` UI requests; returns the applied setting.

description: List the slash-command catalog.

description: Set how queued steering is delivered.

description: Set how queued follow-ups are delivered.

name: compact
description: Compact the conversation.

name: set_auto_compaction
description: Enable or disable auto-compaction.

name: abort_bash
description: Abort the running shell command.

description: Session statistics.

description: Export the session as HTML; returns the written path.

description: Switch to another session file. Give provider and modelId together to override the saved model; otherwise an unavailable saved model fails the request and keeps the current session.

name: branch
description: Branch the session at an entry.

name: fork
description: Fork into a new session file: history through `entryId`, or the whole session.

name: navigate_tree
description: Move the session's leaf to an entry in the same file, optionally summarizing the branch it leaves; refused while busy.

name: abort_branch_summary
description: Stop a running `navigate_tree` branch summary; the navigation is cancelled.

name: set_label
description: Set or clear (omit `label`) an entry's label.

name: get_branch_messages
description: List user messages that can be branched from.

name: get_last_assistant_text
description: Text of the last assistant message, if any.

name: set_session_name
description: Rename the session.

name: handoff
description: Hand the conversation off to a fresh session; null when no handoff was produced.

name: get_messages
description: Every message of the session in one response.

name: get_messages_page
description: One stable page of messages.

name: get_login_providers
description: List OAuth providers and their authentication status.

name: login
description: Run OAuth login; the flow arrives as `open_url` and `input` UI requests.

name: get_logout_accounts
description: List the stored credentials `logout` can remove for a provider, active first.

name: logout
description: Remove one stored credential; fails when it is no longer stored. `remainingSource` names auth that still applies.

name: predict_word
description: Ghost-text suffix for the prose word ending at `cursor` (a UTF-16 offset); null when none applies.

name: predict_word_feedback
description: Report a shown suggestion as accepted or typed past.

description: Ask a side question, or a follow-up in topic `recordId`; returns the record once it is running.

description: Cancel the running side question (only topic `recordId` when given); false when none matches.

name: get_btw_history
description: List the session's side-question records, newest first.
